testcase.system-out: Scenario: Enable and select the orientation control visibility scope ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the orientation control options are open ✔ And showing the orientation control on window creation is enabled ✔ And Only in Current View is selected ✔ When the user clears the show-on-window-creation option ✔ Then the All 3D Views and Only in Current View choices are unavailable ✔ And the position, size and inactive opacity controls remain available ✔ When the user enables the show-on-window-creation option ✔ Then both visibility scope choices are available ✔ And Only in Current View remains selected ✔ When the user selects All 3D Views ✔ Then All 3D Views is selected and Only in Current View is cleared ✔ When the user selects Only in Current View ✔ Then Only in Current View is selected and All 3D Views is cleared ✔ When the user cancels the options ✔ Then the options close and the part view remains displayed
